energy_convention: E(s) = offset + sum_i h_i s_i + sum_{i<j} J_ij s_i s_j, s_i in {-1,+1}
description: Brute-force-verifiable ground-truth optimization instances. Every optimum, degeneracy, and witness is proven by exhaustive enumeration. Use to score a Gibbsiq solver against known-optimal answers.
